t: A ready-made Meshtastic radio with GPS, a small screen, and solar charging.
steps: Buy a Wio Tracker L1 from the Seeed Studio store for about 29 to 44 US dollars. Pick the version with the screen you want.
Screw on the LoRa antenna and the GPS antenna before you power it up.
Plug the board into a USB-C charger or attach a lithium battery.
Install the free Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the tracker with the app over Bluetooth.
Set the LoRa region to match your country. This keeps you on the legal license-free band.
Send your first test message to a friend with a second Meshtastic radio.
Update the firmware later by double-tapping reset and dragging the new file onto the USB drive.
meta: Open Board. From $28.90. A few stores.
